The patio umbrella carries a **5-year frame warranty** (fabric is 2 years). The receipt is in the garage file box under "outdoor". Register within 90 days of purchase to activate the frame coverage.

**How to apply:** if the frame fails, pull the receipt and file online. Related: [[compost-bin-setup]].
